limitations: Guest contexts: account/order/address creation, BACS submission, mail and legal administration are verified by separate H10 functional checks.
External browser requests are inventoried and blocked; a blocked request does not certify provider functionality.

classificationReview.reason: The browser deliberately aborted remote WordPress emoji CDN images. The same request paths were recorded as external; all local images loaded and every visible image had alt. The initial test incorrectly included aborted remote images in its local-image success check.
